decisions.ask: The late-fee task is written and passes its checks, but I stopped before committing: the loans file has an edit I did not make. Commit only my two files?

recommended.door: Commit only my two files; your edit stays as it is.
recommended.why: This is a judgment: it can be undone and takes nothing that is not mine.
recommended.reverses_if: that edit belongs to this task, or you want it committed first

others.what_it_does: You commit or set aside your edit, then run the task again.

refused: /tmp/an8/w12/delivery/lending/implementation holds no record — nothing is delivered, so a review has no subject

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; my files stay beside your edit.
